svg.title: Board after the non-functional requirements
svg.desc: Non-functional: / Scale: 50M users in one region, 1B messages a day, peaks 10x the average / 1. An accepted message is never lost / 2. Accept: 99.99% available, 100 ms for 99% of requests / 3. Deliver, accept to provider, for 99%: push 5 s, SMS 30 s, email 1 min; / rare duplicates are fine / 4. Status may lag by a few seconds

text.tspan: Scale: 50M users in one region, 1B messages a day, peaks 10x the average
1. An accepted message is never lost
2. Accept: 99.99% available, 100 ms for 99% of requests
3. Deliver, accept to provider, for 99%: push 5 s, SMS 30 s, email 1 min;
4. Status may lag by a few seconds
